title: 会议跟进
description: 将最近的会议整理为决策、负责人行动项、待解决事项和明确的下一步。

blocks.title: 最近的会议
blocks.intent: Summarize the most recent substantive meeting inside the selected period, naming the meeting and its source-backed purpose and outcome.

blocks.title: 决策
blocks.intent: List explicit decisions made in the most recent substantive meeting inside the selected period. Do not turn suggestions into decisions.

blocks.title: 行动项
blocks.intent: List explicit action items from the most recent substantive meeting inside the selected period, including owner and timing when stated.

blocks.title: 人员与背景
blocks.intent: Show the people, organizations, roles, and relevant context explicitly present in the most recent substantive meeting inside the selected period.

blocks.title: 待解决事项
blocks.intent: Find unresolved questions, promised follow-ups, and incomplete commitments connected to the most recent meeting inside the selected period.

blocks.title: 下一步做什么
blocks.intent: Recommend the next concrete follow-through step for the most recent meeting based on its explicit decisions, action items, and open loops.
